from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u028/system/state/workspace/programs'); base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    bg=min(set(v for row in g for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in g))
    # The non-background horizontal pattern is the stamp; stamp it centered on each isolated marker.
    rows=len(g); cols=len(g[0])
    pat=None
    for r,row in enumerate(g):
        cells=[(c,v) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg]
        if len(cells)>1:
            lo,hi=cells[0][0],cells[-1][0]
            pat=row[lo:hi+1]
            break
    if pat is None: return g
    markers=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg and v not in pat]
    # identify singleton objects by cells whose color is absent from pattern
    for r,c in markers:
        start=c-len(pat)//2
        for i,v in enumerate(pat):
            if 0<=start+i<cols: g[r][start+i]=v
    return g
'''
